notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Some bug fixes addressed in the latest update:

-  Zone loading issues fixed when traversing from the Mountain Pass / King's Castle areas back to Cathedral Road
-  Cutscene issues fixed after defeating the Chimera in the Temple, as well as the final end cutscenes
-  Save point fixed on the Castle Lookout to prevent the player from entering a permanent falling/death loop when loading at that save point

I appreciate the feedback I've received from new players that picked up the game during the Summer Sale.  Thank you all for giving my game a chance, I truly appreciate it!

As always, feel free to reach out with any questions, comments, or concerns by joining the Discord channel or posting in the Community Hub, and please leave a review!  Any and all feedback is welcome!

Jerry

notes.title: Small Update 1/17/2021
notes.notes:
1.2.2
- Fixed issues with the fog wall going from the bridge in the Cemetery area to the Fortress Bazaar area
- Fixed/Removed some trees growing in places they shouldn't have been as a result of procedural generation
- Fixed some destructible boxes that were scaling up or down when broken
- Added invincibility frames to special abilities.  This should help make them more viable in most combat situations.
- Fixed some trees with missing colliders
- Fixed some environment props with missing textures
- Reduced closing speed of the first boss
- Fixed more audio issues with some enemies later in the game
- Minor performance improvements in various areas of the game
- Less drastic downscaling of textures when changing to lower quality settings while retaining performance increases
- Many more minor changes for overall improvement of the game

Please continue contacting with any and all issues and I will continue to address them as appropriate.  I appreciate all the feedback I've received!

Don't forget to leave a review!

Cheers,

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Upgrade to version 1.2.1

- better rendering pipeline, which improves performance and increases capabilities
- improved visuals and lighting throughout the game with post processing 
- One excessively large level (Ancient Ruins, Old King's Castle, and the Hidden Tomb) was split into 2 separate levels and significantly redesigned for significant performance increases.  It was too big as one giant level, took up too much memory, and I don't have the resources to manage that properly yet.
- Improved level and environmental design in most open areas with new procedural instancing features and higher quality props
- New save point pillar located in cathedral road at an abandoned hut.  This should help provide some relief while exploring this massive open forest area
- Enemies and items may have moved it the redesigned areas, but the same items plus more available find in the world. 
- Save file integrity should remain with this update, but please contact me with any issues.  Players who have progressed far enough in the previously mentioned areas on a saved game may notice duplicates of spawn locations listed in their fast travel menu. This can be ignored and should not happen in new game.

Additional Changes and Notes:

- another round of sound effects balancing and fixes. more to come in the near future
- home screen theme music changed to a better quality soundtrack
- background music added to the sanctuary to give a more tranquil but melancholy feeling
- more tool tips added to the loading screen, and they can be iterated through by pressing A (xbox controller layout) on a gamepad or space on the keyboard 
- when in game and choosing and item to equip in the inventory screen, all items that don't match the chosen slot's equipment type are now greyed out in the inventory contents panel (this actually made it into the last update and I think I forgot to mention it, so it's been live for awhile now)
- weapons that are equipped but you do not have the proper stats to wield them now show a red 'X' over their icon/slot in the equipment panel of the inventory menu.  Check item info for stat requirements. Wielding a weapon without the proper stats results in very slow animation speeds, significantly decreased damage outputs, and spells won't be cast.
-  Cutscenes can be skipped by either pressing Escape on the keyboard, or pressing B (xbox controller layout) on a gamepad to enable a notification sign "Skip" to appear on screen.  Press the same button again before the sign disappears to skip the cutscene.  This has been in the live version for quite some time, but I noticed several content creators didn't know they could do this.  It is currently a tool tip on the loading screen, but due to the amount of tooltips and the random nature of their appearance, it wasn't showing up often enough for players to see it.

Coming in the next few weeks:
- AI improvements to help avoid erratic behaviors and better decision making in combat
- More audio balance fixes and sfx replacements as needed
- a short break for me: my brain hurts and needs it... unless significant bugs are reported and need addressed ASAP

Thank you for the continued support! Current and old players may feel like they are playing a totally different world with the new designs and performance improvements.  I look forward to new players experiencing what I've created and for all to provide me with feedback on how I can make it better going forward!

As always, feel free to engage with me on the Community Hub via Steam or hop into the discord server if you have any questions, concerns, bug reports and suggestions.

Don't forget to leave a review if you've had a chance to play the game!

Thanks again,

Jerry

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The reviews and PMs are coming in already, and I appreciate all of the feedback!  That being said, I understand the expectations of a game like this have not yet been met.  Just know that I am listening and will continue to improve the game to make it a more enjoyable experience for all!

Changes:

- added the ability to walk/move during certain animations, such as using an item and casting certain spells.
- added lighting effects to the pyromancy catalysts' heavy attack flamethrower
- changed the background music for the Hobgoblin General boss fight.
- Hobgoblin boss battle balances:  decreased it's initial attacking distance, added sound effects for effort/weapon attacks/ and when receiving damage, increased turn speed and movement speed
*** I agree with the reviews so far and this battle needed a bit of massaging and can still use some more improvement, but I don't have time for the rest of the today so i thought I'd push out what I have.

Thanks!

notes.title: Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
The time is near! Ready your skills and prepare for battle against the manifestations of mankind's worst nightmare's and repel the incoming evil entity.

Chaos is set for release on Friday, October 30th, 2020.  The time is currently set for 4:00PM EST, but that is fluid and may change on the day, so be ready!.

Your feedback has been heard and much appreciated (good and bad) - keep it coming!  Pay attention to other announcements regarding updates to see what issues have been addressed and what is next on the list!

Thank you, I'm looking forward to you all playing very soon!

notes.title: Small Update: 10/3/2020
notes.notes:
This week: 

I've spent the last week or so preparing the demo version for the Autumn Game Festival by making improvements to the introductory levels "Cemetery" and "Sanctuary." This includes environment updates, new areas, enemy modifications, etc.

Fixes, Additions, and Notes:

- Intro cutscene as been included when starting a new game

- Endings have been included when beating the game.

- Small lighting changes to affect mood throughout the world.  

- More slight tweaks to enemy behavior should make them a bit more responsive.

- New cave area underneath the Sanctuary.  Visit the sanctuary basement to see it.

- New cave area behind the Cemetery.  Head right from first save pyre to see it.

Next week: 

- The demo releases October 7th for the Game Festival.  

- Continued game balance tweaks (enemy health pools, damage outputs, currency collection, leveling rates, etc.).

- Continued refinements and tweaks to player movement.  

Near Future:

-  The game releases fully for sale on October 30th.  

Thank you to all who are testing the game for me - your feedback has been great and I look forward to hearing from you again soon!

notes.title: Small Update: 8/9/2020
notes.notes:
This week: 

i spent time playing through the entire cemetery area checking for environment issues (such as missing collision on trees, issues with terrain slope or places where a player can escape the intended play area, structure placements, etc.), enemy behaviors, and overall feel of the game play.  In doing so, I noticed that at some point while modifying terrain I created other issues.  For example, the location of the stairs to the sanctuary became hidden from the player beneath the terrain but has since been fixed. 

Fixes and Notes:

- Changes in the terrain required a new enemy path finding mesh to be baked as well.  

- Slight tweaks to enemy behavior should make them a bit more responsive.

- Updated a few UI elements, such as the quick menu buttons and background, upgrade vendor buttons and background, and a few others.

- Inventory fixes have been implemented to remove duplication of items, loss of items on transfers between inventory, equipment, and the storage box, and correct quantities being shown.

- Interaction with items in the inventory has been changed as well.  Clicking an item now presents the player with a popup menu with choices to use or drop the item, or cancel the interaction.  This is more intuitive than the previous method of operation and is more clear to the player on how to interact with the inventory.

- Lighting is continuing to be a bane to my existence and I can't seem to produce a result that I'm happy with (issues include the actual visual result, the total time it takes to bake, and memory usage).  I'm looking into alternative solutions to better present the world.

Next week:

My goals for the final weeks before launch are to complete another play through of each area myself and help pick up on any bugs that may not be caught by the testers.  I am also looking for areas that could use a little TLC as far as environment design.  I am no artist, so input certainly helps from an outside perspectives.  

Game balance (enemy health pools, damage outputs, currency collection, leveling rates, etc.) will be addressed in early September as well.

Near Future:

I am waiting for artwork so that I can include the intro and ending cutscenes in the build which will be the final additions to the game.  At this point, no new features will be added prior to release unless significant issues require a massive modification.

Thank you to all who are testing the game for me - your feedback has been great and I look forward to hearing from you again soon!
